summary: Retain audited whole-tree stop confirmations and uncertain stops (unit 9a)

replay.detail: Jobs-only projection retains generation-bound stop audit and usage. Bare WholeTreeStopped transition records are refused; acknowledgements require an audited sampled stop record.

schema.detail: Adds stop-started and stop-resolved job.recorded variants; no SQL schema or shared writer changes.

rules.detail: INACTIVE. Only pending cancellation can become cancelled after a confirmed whole-tree stop. Uncertain stop keeps cancel-requested. No timing defaults or production caller.

compatibility.detail: Repeated stop acknowledgement is idempotent. Natural ChildExit under cancellation does not bypass whole-tree confirmation, consistent with unit 8.

manual.detail: Pure and real-projection replay fixtures added; cargo and native execution not run.

recovery.detail: Retains typed uncertainty or counters-unavailable, never fabricated zero usage. Reserved operator audit requires a deployment-pinned authenticated PERSON grant; no endpoint is exposed.
